CAD-to-Revit Structural Modeling · Revit Add-in

Foundation Modeling

Build foundations from the CAD plan.

Turn CAD outlines into isolated footings and rafts in Revit. Group repeated geometry into shared types and review thicknesses and level offsets by type.

Request Demo on WhatsApp Compare Workflows
Key features

Put foundation types and elevations under one review

Repeated outlines often represent the same foundation type. Group them, set naming and thickness rules, and spend the review on differences that affect the model.

  • 01

    Reads boundary geometry from a selected CAD layer → generates the correct Revit family instance

  • 02

    Recognizes identical geometries and groups them into a single Revit type — no manual type definition needed

  • 03

    Auto-naming based on dimensions + user-defined prefix (e.g. F1, F2… or BC1, BC2…)

  • 04

    Summary table after modeling

    edit thickness per type and click Apply

  • 05

    RC foundations

    set thickness in the CAD layer name — the tool reads it automatically

  • 06

    Mixed drawings supported

    plain and RC foundations processed in one session

  • 07

    Automatic level offset per foundation thickness for correct elevation

Workflow comparison

Manual Revit vs. Foundation Modeling

TaskManual Revit workflowWith Foundation Modeling
Identify repeated foundation shapesManual Revit workflowMeasure outlines and set up Revit types for each repeated size.With Foundation ModelingRead the selected CAD layer and group matching geometry into shared types.
Set names and thicknessesManual Revit workflowName types and edit their thicknesses in Revit.With Foundation ModelingApply naming prefixes and review thicknesses in the type summary.
Place at the correct elevationManual Revit workflowPlace foundation elements and check each level offset.With Foundation ModelingGenerate elements with thickness-based offsets and review elevations.
